claims.claim: Timeouts in urllib3 control how long requests are allowed to run before being aborted.
claims.citation: Timeouts allow you to control how long (in seconds) requests are allowed to run before being aborted.

claims.claim: Timeouts in urllib3 are specified in seconds.
claims.citation: how long (in seconds) requests are allowed to run

claims.claim: In simple cases, a timeout can be specified as a float to urllib3's request().
claims.citation: In simple cases, you can specify a timeout as a `float` to `request()`

claims.claim: A urllib3.Timeout instance can be used for more granular control over timeouts.
claims.citation: For more granular control you can use a `Timeout` instance

claims.claim: A urllib3 Timeout instance lets you specify separate connect and read timeouts.
claims.citation: which lets you specify separate connect and read timeouts

claims.claim: A timeout can be specified at the urllib3 PoolManager level so that all requests are subject to the same timeout.
claims.citation: If you want all requests to be subject to the same timeout, you can specify the timeout at the `PoolManager` level

claims.claim: A pool-level timeout set on a urllib3 PoolManager can be overridden by specifying timeout to request().
claims.citation: You still override this pool-level timeout by specifying `timeout` to `request()`.
